description: IR501T/UT large missile impact storefront, dry glazed

glass.build: 1-5/16" laminated IG: 1/4" HS or tempered exterior / 1/2" spacer / 1/4" HS / 0.090 DuPont SG (SentryGlas) / 1/4" HS interior

glazing: Dry glazed: exterior glazing gasket (35) and interior wedge/spacer gasket (36); 5/8" min. bite; setting blocks at sill, W blocks at sides (sheet 8). Gaskets per ASTM C864 or C509.
